serviceDescription: Contains the most recent imagery collected by the NC Orthoimagery Program for any given area of North Carolina. The imagery is natural color (3-band, JPEG compression) and has a pixel resolution of 6 inches with an RMSE of 1.0 ft X and Y. Individual pixel values may have been altered during image processing.
